'''Lena Ganschow''' (born 1980) is a German journalist and television moderator.

== Life ==
Lena Ganschow was born in 1980 in [[Hamburg]], Germany and grew up there.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|last=|first=|date=2015-10-28|title=Zur Person: Lena Ganschow|work=DIE WELT|url=https://www.welt.de/print/die_welt/hamburg/article148156033/Zur-Person-Lena-Ganschow.html|access-date=2020-11-01}}</ref>

After graduating from the [[European School, Karlsruhe|European School in Karlsruhe]], Ganschow studied biology at the Eberhard Karls [[University of Tübingen]] and [[Tufts University]] in [[Medford, Massachusetts]]. She wrote her thesis at [[Christiane Nüsslein-Volhard]] at the [[Max Planck Institute for Developmental Biology]] in Tübingen.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Vita {{!}} Lena Ganschow|url=http://lenaganschow.de/vita/|access-date=2020-11-01|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Biografie: Lena Ganschow: ZDF Presseportal|url=https://presseportal.zdf.de/biografie/Person/lena-ganschow/|access-date=2020-11-01|website=presseportal.zdf.de|language=de}}</ref>

From 2006 to 2007, she was a volunteer and from 2007 freelance at [[Südwestrundfunk]] (SWR). She worked as a reporter for the program ''[[odysso]]'' at [[SWR Fernsehen]]. In the documentaries ''Die Römer im Südwesten'', ''Die Kelten im Südwesten'' and ''Das Mittelalter im Südwesten'', Ganschow went back in time as a presenter in search of traces. In addition, she moderated the series ''Schatzsuche im Schloss'' together with art expert Frithjof Hampel at [[Das Erste]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2015-03-28|title=Schatzsuche im Schloss (1) - Schlösser wie im Märchen|url=http://www.ardmediathek.de/tv/Reportage-Dokumentation/Schatzsuche-im-Schloss-1-Schl%C3%B6sser-w/Das-Erste/Video?documentId=27356654&bcastId=799280|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150711110247/http://www.ardmediathek.de/tv/Reportage-Dokumentation/Schatzsuche-im-Schloss-1-Schl%C3%B6sser-w/Das-Erste/Video?documentId=27356654&bcastId=799280|archive-date=11 July 2015|access-date=2020-11-01|website=ARD Mediathek|language=de}}</ref>

From September 2012 to October 2015, she was a moderator for the show ''[[Kaffee oder Tee]]'' on SWR Fernsehen.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Job {{!}} Lena Ganschow|url=http://lenaganschow.de/job/|access-date=2020-11-01|language=de-DE}}</ref> On November 1, 2015, she succeeded [[Dirk Steffens (journalist)|Dirk Steffens]] as the presenter of the knowledge magazine ''[[Terra Xpress]]'' on [[Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen]] (ZDF).<ref>{{Cite news|last=|first=|date=2015-11-01|title=Sie zählt: Lena Ganschow kommt|work=DIE WELT|url=https://www.welt.de/print/wams/hamburg/article148287526/Lena-Ganschow-kommt.html|access-date=2020-11-01}}</ref>

Ganschow is married and has a child.<ref name=":0" />
